text: Anndee, ko Allah woodani, diina laaɓuka e sirku kan. Ɓen non ɓe ɓeya jogitori yiɗɓe gaanin Allah, immorde e sanamuuji e bewinayɗi, ɗi ɓe rewata ɓe acca Allah, ɓe wona e ngantinorgol ɗum, wiide: Men rewiraali ɗii, si wanaa tun no ɓadinira men ka Allah, martaba, ɗi hewtina Mo haajuuji amen, ɗi tefana men ka Makko. Pellet, Allah ñaawoyay hakkunde gomɗimɓe wootimɓe Mo ɓen, e yedduɓe sirkuɓe ɓen, Ñalnde Darngal, e kon ko ɓe luutondiraynoo e mun, ka tawhiidi. Pellet, Allah fewnataa e goonga, on fenoowo dammba e Alla sirku, dullanoowo neemaaji Allah ɗin e makko.
